title: Shoe Size, Age of Child, and Reading Ability
content: David Freedman's example states the causal graph Shoe Size <- Age of Child -> Reading Ability. Age explains the observed association; changing shoe size does not change reading ability. The source then discusses conditioning on age.

variables.name: Age of Child
variables.content: Age of Child is the common source variable in the printed example.

variables.name: Shoe Size
variables.content: Shoe Size is one effect variable in the printed example.
